problem: Self-hosted per-run directories accumulate while broad cleanup risks active tasks and unique runtime evidence.
invariant: Post-job cleanup owns only exact run/attempt paths; global maintenance requires idle admission and a hash-bound reviewed plan. Preserve shared Git owners, protected refs, active caches and byte-verifiable rollback before pruning.
failure_behavior: Unknown ownership, drift, reparse points, insufficient archive space or failed archive readback stop mutation and retain original bytes.
